cap: The sacral plexus lies on the piriformis, which splits the greater sciatic foramen: only the superior gluteal nerve and vessels pass above it. The levator ani (puborectalis, pubococcygeus, iliococcygeus) and the coccygeus form the floor. In the bladder, parasympathetic pelvic splanchnic nerves contract the detrusor through muscarinic M3 receptors to void, sympathetic hypogastric nerves relax it and close the internal sphincter to store, and the pudendal nerve controls the external sphincter.
